responsibility: Defines PA-RISC-specific machine modes and floating-point format properties used by GCC’s mode generator. It resets SF/DF/TF floating formats to the PA/MIPS-style quiet-bit layout, introduces the `CCFP` condition-code mode used for PA floating-point comparisons, and defines the `OI` integer mode used for signed-overflow checking, giving the backend its target-specific mode inventory beyond the generic defaults.
